charts.title: Gross Profit, Net Income (Attributable) & Total Profit Incl. NCI
charts.annotation: Net income is profit attributable to parent shareholders; total profit incl. NCI also includes the share paid out to non-controlling interests.

charts.title: Net Income vs Free Cash Flow vs Owner FCF
charts.annotation: Owner FCF, where shown, is the DCF's series after SBC, interest income and lease principal.

balanceSheet.title: Balance sheet
balanceSheet.content:
Shareholders' equity is assets less liabilities; plotted against total liabilities to show leverage.

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): equity that grows only through revaluations or share issues is not the same as retained earnings.

What to watch:

  • Liabilities growing faster than equity
  • Goodwill share of equity after acquisitions

cashDebt.title: Cash and debt
cashDebt.content:
Cash & equivalents against total borrowings (leases excluded unless noted).

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): the DCF's net-debt bridge uses these balances at the latest balance-sheet date.

What to watch:

  • Net debt trend versus EBITDA
  • Refinancing dates and covenants in the filings

epsDps.title: EPS and dividends
epsDps.content:
EPS is net income per share; DPS is the cash dividend paid per share. Both are in major currency units.

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): the payout ratio (DPS / EPS) shows how much of earnings is returned versus reinvested.

What to watch:

  • EPS growth versus net income growth (dilution)
  • Dividends funded from earnings, not debt

fcf.title: Free cash flow
fcf.content:
Reported FCF is operating cash flow less capital expenditure. Owner FCF (from the DCF) further deducts stock-based compensation, interest income and lease principal -- the cash an owner could actually take out.

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): the gap between net income and owner FCF is the earnings-quality question the valuation is built on.

What to watch:

  • FCF persistently below net income
  • Working-capital swings inflating one year's FCF

margins.title: Margins
margins.content:
Gross margin is revenue less cost of revenue; operating margin deducts operating expenses; net margin is after interest and tax.

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): the spread between gross and operating margin is the cost of running the business; a widening spread with flat gross margin means opex is growing faster than sales.

What to watch:

  • Direction of operating margin over several years, not one
  • One-offs (impairments, disposals) that distort net margin

ocfCapex.title: Operating cash flow and CapEx
ocfCapex.content:
Operating cash flow is cash generated by operations; CapEx is cash invested in fixed and intangible assets.

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): CapEx here is shown as stored (sign convention varies by ticker); the DCF splits it into stay-in-business and growth where disclosed.

What to watch:

  • CapEx rising faster than revenue
  • OCF that diverges from EBITDA

profit.title: Profit lines
profit.content:
Gross profit is revenue less cost of revenue. Net income is profit attributable to parent shareholders only -- what EPS is based on. Total profit incl. NCI is group profit before splitting out the share paid to non-controlling interests (minority stakes in consolidated subsidiaries).

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): the attributable/total gap is widening -- NCI took roughly RMB51.6m of FY2025's RMB1,154m total profit (net income of RMB1,103m attributable to parent), up from a smaller share in FY2024. That gap is real economic profit the parent does not own, even though the consolidated revenue and cost lines above it are 100% consolidated.

What to watch:

  • The NCI share of total profit growing faster than revenue (a subsidiary with minority partners scaling faster than the wholly-owned business)
  • Net income far from operating income (interest, tax, one-offs) separately from the NCI gap

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.content:
Revenue is the top line: what customers paid for goods and services in the period, before any costs.

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): the growth rate matters more than the level; compare it with the DCF's base-case growth path below.

What to watch:

  • Acceleration or deceleration in YoY growth
  • Whether growth is organic or acquired
  • Interim rows show seasonality

sbc.title: Stock-based compensation and share count
sbc.content:
Stock-based comp is the expense of equity awards; shares outstanding shows the dilution it causes net of buybacks.

For Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. (上海上美化妝品股份有限公司): the DCF charges SBC as a cash cost and holds the share count flat, so this chart is the check on that assumption.

What to watch:

  • Share count rising while buybacks are advertised
  • SBC as a percentage of revenue
